title: Intel and Farce
next_chapter_hook: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his Eye of Breaking the Game quietly activated, and the trackers' seemingly airtight encirclement had become lambs awaiting slaughter in his vision.

text.content: The ancient, yellowed characters on the secret letter stabbed into Chen Ji's eyes like blades—a name he had never heard before, yet intimately connected to the ultimate secret of the Tianji Record. Just as he was about to examine it closely, a black shadow swept past the window, and a pale white hand swiftly snatched away the secret letter. "What has you so engrossed?" Ye Qing leaned one hand on the windowsill, waving the letter with a teasing tone, "The things I asked you to watch aren't just this one." She slapped another perfectly sealed letter onto the table, "Genuine intel, look at this first."

dialogue.content: The Second Elder among the Five Elders has been unusually active lately, frequently contacting outside forces. My people have been watching him for three days, discovering he meets someone at the ruined temple west of the city every two days. The visitor's identity is unknown, but the transmission jade talisman they use... employs Demonic Path techniques.

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the first secret letter into his sleeve, his expression unchanged: "Demonic Path techniques? Which Demonic Path?" Ye Qing冷笑一声: "Do you think the Holy Sect has been quiet lately for no reason? Because they're making their move. Among the Five Elders, someone wants to use outside forces to purge dissidents, and the Holy Sect... just happens to want the Five Elders to muddy the waters of the Tianqing Sect." She tapped her fingers lightly on the table, "Has your old fox of a Sect Master shown any abnormalities lately?"

dialogue.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze, his fingertips unconsciously stroking the rim of his teacup. He recalled Ling Yuan's increasingly 'attentive' attitude toward him these days—that smile-hiding-a-knife gentleness, which perfectly matched the Second Elder's abnormalities described in the intelligence. After a moment, he looked up: "Whose people are tracking us?"

"Xuanwu Sect people." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, "That rival of yours Han Lie sent an elite squad, six Golden Core stage cultivators, they've been following us for three days. However..." Her tone shifted, a mischievous glint flickering in her eyes, "Your precious little sister has provided us quite some entertainment." Before she finished speaking, a rustling sound came from outside the door, followed by a sweet voice: "Brother~ I'm back! How's my new disguise?"

text.content: The door swung open as Chen Nian made a dazzling entrance with a rainbow-colored wig. Her face was covered in makeup of unknown origin, her eyebrows painted thick and black, her lips like sausages, and she wore a floral jacket that looked like it came from some market stall. She put her hands on her hips, striking a pose she thought was captivating: "Well? Can't recognize who I am now?" Chen Ji's expression remained impassive. Ye Qing was already laughing so hard she was pounding the table: "Hahaha—Chen Nian, did you come here to put on a show?"

dialogue.content: Chen Nian glared at Ye Qing不服气地: "What do you know! This is called commoner's hiding technique! I observed the marketplaces for three days, and those aunties all dress like this!" She spun around, the sequins on her floral jacket jingling, "And I tell you, when I came in just now, the gatekeeper Uncle Zhang didn't recognize me at all! He asked if I was a new servant girl!"

text.content: Chen Ji lifted his teacup for a sip, calmly said: "Uncle Zhang is three hundred degrees nearsighted, you could wear a gunny sack and he still wouldn't recognize you." Chen Nian's smile froze on her face. Ye Qing laughed even harder: "Little sister, if your disguise can fool anyone, I'll eat my nighttime boots on the spot!" Chen Nian flushed red, stamping her foot: "Hmph! Just you wait! I'll go change into something even more powerful!" With that, she started rushing outside.

dialogue.content: "Hold it." Chen Ji put down his teacup, his voice soft yet carrying undeniable authority, "There are six people watching us outside, and if you go out dressed like that, aren't you clearly telling them 'come track me'?" Chen Nian's movement stopped, she turned back and blinked: "But... I think I look quite good?" Ye Qing wiped away her tears of laughter: "You look good, yes, but if you go out like that, the Xuanwu Sect people will definitely think we're deliberately insulting them."

text.content: Chen Ji stood up, walked to the window, his gaze sweeping across the street outside. At the tea stall on the corner, a man in gray robes was leisurely sipping tea; the fortune-teller at the alley mouth appeared to be dozing off, but his eyes occasionally swept toward this direction; even the old man selling sugar-coated hawthorns by the road moved his cart with a rhythm unique to cultivators. He murmured: "Six people, three in the open, three hidden. The two in the open are bait, the real动手的会是暗处的 three."

choice.prompt: The trackers' encirclement was now clear, and Chen Ji needed to decide his next move.

choices.description: Use the trackers' belief in their own concealment to set a trap in reverse, letting them walk right into it.
choices.visible_cost: Expend minimal spirit stones to set up an illusion formation
choices.visible_reward: Gather Xuanwu Sect intelligence while weakening the enemy's tracking ability
choices.risk_hint: If the formation is identified, it may expose our true intentions

text.content: A faint smile curved Chen Ji's lips as he turned to retrieve a set of formation plates: "Since they want to fish, let's give them a 'guest entering the urn' treatment." Ye Qing took the formation plates, a hint of appreciation flashing in her eyes: "You're planning to use an illusion formation to create a false trail, making them think we're going east, when actually..." Chen Ji nodded: "We're actually crossing the city west, and by the time they realize, we'll be drinking tea at the Second Elder's secret meeting spot."

choices.text: Take the Initiative to Flush Out the Enemy
choices.description: Directly strike the trackers in the open, forcing the three hidden ones to reveal themselves for a complete capture.
choices.visible_reward: Completely eliminate the tracking threat while gaining real combat training opportunities
choices.risk_hint: The commotion might attract more trouble

text.content: Chen Ji fiddled with the formation plate in his hand, then suddenly laughed lightly: "No need to be that troublesome." He stepped toward the door, "I'll go meet that old sugar-coated hawthorn seller." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "By yourself?" Chen Ji looked back, a hint of playfulness in his eyes: "Six Golden Core stage cultivators, do I really need three people to handle them?"

choices.description: Deliberately let the pursuers think they've succeeded, guiding them to report false intelligence to Han Lie.
choices.visible_reward: Let Han Lie receive misleading intelligence, creating conditions for subsequent arrangements

text.content: Chen Ji pondered for a moment, a meaningful smile curving his lips: 'Let them follow. But we're not hiding from them—we're letting them think they're tracking us.' Ye Qing immediately understood: 'You want them to bring a message to Han Lie? What message?' Chen Ji looked out the window, his gaze deep and distant: 'Bring Han Lie the news he's been dreaming of—about my 'true strength'.'

Just as Chen Ji's words fell, Chen Nian suddenly poked her head out from behind the screen, holding a bronze mirror that reflected a completely different face—thick eyebrows, large eyes, full beard, the very image of a wandering rogue. 'Wait! I went back and changed!' She strode out triumphantly, wearing borrowed coarse cloth garments with a notched blade at her waist. 'This should work, right?'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji glanced at her and fell silent for a moment: 'Do you know who you look like right now?' Chen Nian blinked: 'Who?' Chen Ji's expression remained impassive: 'Like that pig that ran away from Butcher Wang's place in the east of the city.' Ye Qing collapsed into laughter again. Chen Nian's face flushed crimson: 'Chen Ji, that's enough! I'm your actual sister!' Chen Ji shrugged: 'Precisely because you're my sister, I'm being honest.'

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's 'disguise' failed once again, but she didn't seem ready to give up.

choices.text: Let her participate in setting up the trap
choices.description: Since she's so enthusiastic, why not give her a proper task, such as participating in setting up counter-tracking traps.
choices.visible_cost: Need to divert attention to look after her
choices.visible_reward: Chen Nian gains combat experience, siblings become more coordinated
choices.risk_hint: She might cause more harm than good

text.content: Chen Ji sighed, pulling out a talisman from his chest and handing it to her: 'Since you're so eager to prove yourself, help me with something. This is a Qi Concealing Talisman—once you attach it to your body, your aura will be temporarily suppressed. When we move later, you'll observe from the shadows. If anything seems amiss, crush the talisman.' Chen Nian's eyes lit up: 'What kind of task is this?' Chen Ji replied coolly: 'Observer. The most critical position of all.'

choices.text: Continue to crush her disguise enthusiasm
choices.description: Use harsher words to make her face reality, while also teaching her proper concealment techniques.
choices.visible_reward: Chen Ji demonstrates his true abilities, making Chen Nian convinced

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand and, before Chen Nian could react, plucked the false eyebrows from her face. He held them before her eyes: 'The first essential of disguise is observation. Do you know what's most crucial about concealment? It's not what clothes you wear or makeup you apply—it's aura.' His fingertip touched Chen Nian's brow center. 'The Heavenly Dao aura on you is so strong that even a three-year-old could detect it.'

Chen Nian unconsciously touched her brow center, somewhat defiant: 'Then why have I never sensed it?' Ye Qing walked over, unusually serious for once: 'Because you're used to it. Like a fish becomes accustomed to water and stops noticing its existence.' She patted Chen Nian's shoulder. 'Kid, what your brother means is—your Heavenly Fate Key aura is like holding a torch in the darkness. Impossible to hide.'

dialogue.content: Chen Nian fell silent for a moment, then suddenly looked up, her gaze turning serious: 'Then... if my aura can't be concealed, have they been tracking me all along?' Chen Ji didn't answer, but his silence was answer enough. Ye Qing sighed: 'That's why your brother has kept you by his side. Those people weren't tracking your brother—they were after you.' Chen Nian's face turned slightly pale.

text.content: The atmosphere grew heavy for a moment. But then Chen Ji laughed lightly: 'So this performance needs a different approach.' He paced to the window, gazing at those pursuers outside who thought themselves hidden. 'Since they want Chen Nian, we'll give them a 'Chen Nian'.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: 'What do you mean?' Chen Ji turned, his eyes gleaming with calculation: 'Let the pursuers personally 'witness' Chen Nian falling into their hands—of course, it'll be fake.'

choice.prompt: Chen Ji proposed a bold plan that required Ye Qing and Chen Nian to execute together.

choices.text: Agreement on the plan, each fulfilling their role
choices.description: According to Chen Ji's arrangement, Ye Qing was responsible for setting up the illusion array, Chen Ji for luring out the prey, and Chen Nian for closing the net at the end.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully countered the pursuers, gaining a moment to breathe
choices.risk_hint: If coordination fails, everything could be undone

text.content: Ye Qing listened to the plan, his eyes glittering: 'Brilliant. Use the illusion formation to create a假象 of you breaking through with Chen Nian, while you two hide in the shadows watching my performance. When they think they've succeeded, what greets them will be my demonic path mist—at which point they won't even know how they got caught.' Chen Ji nodded: 'Remember, keep them alive. Intelligence from Xuanwu Sect is worth far more than these small fries.'

choices.text: Propose modifications to the plan, adding an intelligence-gathering环节
choices.description: Based on the original plan, add the环节 of extracting intelligence about Han Lie from the pursuers.
choices.visible_reward: May obtain Han Lie's core strategic布局 intelligence
choices.risk_hint: Interrogation requires time, potentially exposing our whereabouts

text.content: Ye Qing pondered: 'Are you trying to skip the interrogation entirely? Make the pursuers send the intelligence back themselves?' Chen Ji smirked: 'A man like Han Lie loves hearing his subordinates report 'battle results'. Instead of us interrogating小喽啰, let's let Han Lie tell us himself—what he truly wants from Chen Nian.' Ye Qing clapped his hands in delight: 'Using a blade to kill, no, using their mouths to deliver messages. Clever, truly brilliant.'

The plan was set. Ye Qing began preparing the illusion formation. Though Chen Nian had been badly shaken, hearing he could participate in the行动 gave him renewed energy, and he studied the concealment talisman techniques intently nearby. Just then, a soft sound came from outside the window. Chen Ji's gaze instantly sharpened, his hand already pressing against the formation disc hidden in his sleeve. But the next moment, a familiar voice came through the window: 'Chen-shixiong, it's me, Su Qingyao.'

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao climbed through the window, her gaze sweeping across the three people in the room before landing on Chen Ji, her expression complex: 'The Second Elder suddenly convened an elder meeting today, saying there was important business. I felt something was off, so I came to check on you.' Her gaze lingered on Ye Qing for a moment, frowning slightly, 'And the Night Holy Maiden is here too?' Ye Qing waved magnanimously: 'Hello, Su-xiaozhang, perfect timing—we're about to put on quite a show.'

text.content: Chen Ji glanced at Su Qingyao, quickly calculating in his mind. Su Qingyao was the only person who had sensed something was wrong with him, but she was also one of his most unlikely allies to betray him—at least for now. After a moment's deliberation, he decided to give her a choice: 'Su-shimei, the Second Elder convening an elder meeting at this time must have ulterior motives. If you return, perhaps you can gather some intelligence.' He paused, 'But if you stay... you can help us complete this 'good show'.' Ye Qing raised an eyebrow at Chen Ji, clearly waiting for him to continue.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, her gaze moving between Ye Qing and Chen Ji, then suddenly let out a soft laugh: 'Chen-shixiong, you're getting better at giving me multiple-choice questions.' She walked to the window, glancing at the street outside, 'Are the Second Elder's people... related to these pursuers?' Chen Ji didn't answer, but his silence said everything. Su Qingyao turned around, a flash of determination in her eyes: 'Fine, I'll stay. The elders can wait.'

text.content: Ye Qing whistled: 'Oh my, the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow skipping an elder meeting for a servant disciple—if this gets out...' Su Qingyao gave her a cold glance: 'And didn't the Night Holy Maiden also betray the Holy Sect for the same 'servant disciple'?' Ye Qing shrugged, neither confirming nor denying. Chen Nian watched the confrontation between the two women, then muttered quietly: 'Why do I feel like the atmosphere is a bit strange...' Chen Ji cleared his throat, breaking the subtle standoff: 'Alright, now that we're all here, let's discuss the formal plan. Our goal is to make the pursuers walk into our trap before tonight falls.' His gaze swept across the four people present, a faint smile curling his lips: 'Let them understand—traps set by废物 aren't so easy to break.'
